## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4e99a54a6a5d2ec5dcf99b07fe689757ac131807`

Reviewed against the merge-base `d461b0de87b49693bebc0a853abe5c5e4d1d9613` (the second parent of the head's merge commit; `git diff` of that base to the head is exactly the four files below, and the fix commit `a75bf59` diffed against its own parent `111fa4c` is byte-identical on those four paths). Everything below was read from `refs/review/pr-10548` and `refs/review/main`; the shared tree was not checked out. The `os-dev-report` comment's claims were not used as evidence. The PR's local test and gate numbers are the author's claims, not this review's measurements: the objectui tree has no `node_modules`, and the only run this review counts is CI at the head.

### ① Derived judgments

**Behaviour changes the diff introduces, judged against the card, the triage comment and the ruled shape.**

1. `packages/components/src/renderers/form/select.tsx:62` — `Label htmlFor={schema.id}` (base: `Label` with no `htmlFor`). Card: "Give the trigger the schema's `id`, and give the label `htmlFor` to it." Triage (comment 5827499486): "the trigger gets the schema's `id`, the label gets `htmlFor`." RIGHT. The `Label` primitive (`packages/components/src/ui/label.tsx:26-30`) spreads its props onto the Radix label root, so `htmlFor` reaches the `label` element.
2. `packages/components/src/renderers/form/select.tsx:86` — `SelectTrigger id={schema.id}` (base: no `id`). Same ruling. RIGHT. `SelectTrigger` (`packages/components/src/ui/select.tsx:57-64`) spreads its props onto the Radix trigger, and that trigger is the `button` with `role="combobox"` that the existing green pin on main already locates with `screen.getByRole('combobox')` against this very renderer (`required-marker-markup.test.tsx`, select site).
3. `packages/components/src/renderers/form/select.tsx:50-60` — an 11-line comment explaining the pair and the no-fallback choice. Prose checked below; every sentence is true against the code. Within the claimed file surface.
4. No `useId()` fallback: a select authored without `schema.id` still renders no `for` and no `id`. The card and the triage both bind the wiring to "the schema's `id`", and the ruled `record-picker-label-association-5771` changeset says verbatim: "wired **when `schema.id` exists**, matching `element:text_input`'s precedent rather than an always-on `useId()` fallback. Only the author can supply `schema.id`, so a picker authored without one keeps its pre-fix, unassociated caption text exactly as before; nothing about this change mints an id the author did not provide." RIGHT to follow it; a minted id would be a family-wide reversal of the #5735 / #5771 answer that no card asks for. `id` is already on `BaseSchema` (`packages/types/src/base.ts:83`), so no new key is consumed.
5. The Radix `Select` root, the registration block (`select.tsx:99-125`, `inputs` and `defaultProps`) and the `SelectRenderer` export are untouched. Nothing else in the renderer moved.

**Asked and delivered.**

- Card pin ask: "a labelled `ui:select` is found by `getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Title' })`" — `select-label-association.test.tsx:50`. Delivered.
- Card pin ask: "a required one's name stays `Title`" — `select-label-association.test.tsx:56-66` (marker present and `aria-hidden`, name `Title`, `aria-required="true"`). Delivered.
- Claim file surface: `select.tsx` (label `htmlFor` plus trigger `id` only) — delivered as items 1 and 2 plus a comment; "a pin beside the existing select renderer tests" — the new file sits in `packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/`, beside the six `form-builtin-select-*.test.tsx` files; "one `.changeset/10435-…md`" — `.changeset/10435-select-label-association.md`. Delivered.
- #5771's resolution rule ("pin the resolution … not the two attributes separately") is honoured: every associated case resolves end to end (`getByRole` by name, `toHaveAccessibleName`, `getElementById` on the `for` value, `trigger.labels`), never `htmlFor` and `id` as two strings.

**Done but not asked.**

- `packages/components/src/__tests__/required-marker-markup.test.tsx:136-138` is outside the claim's declared file surface. What changed: the select site's locator went from `document.querySelector('label')` to `document.querySelector('label[for="sel-ctl"]')`, and the comment "This label carries no `for` today … deliberately not pinned either way" was replaced by "The label names the trigger through `for` since objectui#10435". The old comment became false the moment item 1 landed, so leaving it would have shipped prose that contradicts the code. Test-only, unpublished, explained in the PR body. Justified; not a defect.
- Nothing else outside the ask. No docs, no registration prose, no types.

**Existing pins edited or deleted.**

- Edited: `required-marker-markup.test.tsx` select site (above). The flip is a tightening, not a weakening: the old locator matched any `label` and would still have passed after the fix; the new one returns null when the `for` is lost, so `expect(el).not.toBeNull()` at `:149` and `:167` goes red on a regression of item 1. The two assertions the file exists for (no generated content, one `aria-hidden` marker, text outside `aria-hidden` is `Title`, `aria-required` on the combobox) are unchanged. Load-bearing.
- Deleted: none.

**Can the new pins fail? (`select-label-association.test.tsx`, 7 cases)**

- Negative leg, by construction against the base blob `4296933c`: cases 1, 2, 4, 5, 7 call `getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Title' })` or `toHaveAccessibleName('Title')`; on the base the trigger has no `id`, no `for` points at it, and `combobox` takes no name from content, so the name is `''` and each throws. Case 3 queries `label[for]`, null on the base, and fails at `:73`. Case 6 (no-id) is green on the base by design: it pins the half that does not change. That the name reader returns `''` for an unlabelled Radix trigger with placeholder text is not assumed: the green main pin `record-picker-label-association.test.tsx:130-132` asserts exactly that on the same `SelectTrigger` primitive.
- Lit control: case 6 uses the same instrument (`toHaveAccessibleName`) and reads `''`, so a reader that trivially echoed the label would fail it; cases 4 and 5 assert `toHaveTextContent('Choose…')` / `'Ms'` next to `toHaveAccessibleName('Title')`, so the name is shown to come from the label and not the trigger's content. Case 3 and case 7 read `trigger.labels` (happy-dom implements it: the same read is green on main at `record-picker-label-association.test.tsx:104-107`), and `?? []` does not soften them, since `[]` never equals `[label]`.
- Case 7 renders through `SchemaRenderer` and asserts `labels` equals the one `label[for="title"]`; that also guards against a duplicate `id` landing on a wrapper (`SchemaRenderer.tsx:2180` writes `data-obj-id`, not `id`, so none is expected).
- The file is under a directory the `dom` vitest project already runs (65 sibling test files there), it registers the renderers at module scope, and the components `tsconfig.test.json` includes `*.test.tsx`. Its prose cites by symbol and test name only; no `path:line` address anywhere in the diff (AGENTS.md #11).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/10435-select-label-association.md`: `'@object-ui/components': patch`. The diff changes published `src` of a released package in the `fixed` group, so a changeset is owed (AGENTS.md, changeset presence rule) and one is declared; it is not `major` (AGENTS.md 版本号策略: never `major`; CI `Changeset Bump Policy` green at the head). An a11y bug fix that adds two DOM attributes and changes no schema key, no export and no registration is a patch. Not a docs-only change, so the empty-frontmatter form does not apply. RIGHT.

Changeset prose, sentence by sentence, against the diff:

1. "The `ui:select` form renderer's `label` now names its combobox (objectui#10435)." TRUE when `id` is authored; the closing sentence states the other half.
2. "Before, the renderer drew its `Label` with no `htmlFor` and the Radix `SelectTrigger` with no `id`, and nothing set `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`." TRUE: the base hunk is `Label className=…` and `SelectTrigger className={className}`; the head file has no `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` and the diff adds none, so the base had none.
3. "The trigger is a `button` with `role="combobox"`, a role that takes no name from its content, so the placeholder and value text inside it did not name it either: a labelled select's combobox had an empty accessible name, and a screen reader announced an unnamed combobox." TRUE: role confirmed by the existing `getByRole('combobox')` pin on this renderer; combobox is not a name-from-content role; the card measured `''` in Chromium's tree.
4. "The fix is the shape `element:record_picker` landed for the same defect (objectui#5771): the trigger gets the node's `id`, and the label gets `htmlFor` to it." TRUE: `record-picker.tsx:267` `Label htmlFor={schema?.id}`, `:277` `id={schema?.id}`.
5. "A labelled select authored with an `id` is now named by its label, and a required one's name leaves out the `*`, because the required marker is an `aria-hidden` element (objectui#10368)." TRUE: `select.tsx:71` marker span carries `aria-hidden="true"`; pinned at test `:61-65`.
6. "A select authored without an `id` is unchanged: the renderer mints no id, so its caption stays unassociated, as on the sibling `input` and `textarea` renderers." TRUE: no `useId` in the file; `input.tsx:48/64` and `textarea.tsx:43/58` wire `htmlFor={schema.id}` / `id={schema.id}` with no fallback.

Code-comment prose added by the diff (`select.tsx:50-60`): "the shape `element:record_picker` landed … (objectui#5771)" TRUE; "`SelectTrigger` renders a `button` with `role="combobox"`, a labelable element" TRUE (a `button` is labelable); "that role takes no name from its content" TRUE; "Only the author supplies `schema.id`" TRUE (`BaseSchema.id` optional, no fallback); "as on the sibling `input` / `textarea` renderers, rather than a minted `useId()` fallback" TRUE.

Test-file prose: the header restates the card (TRUE as above); "the no-`id` case pins that the renderer mints none, the same deliberate half that shape pins for the picker" TRUE (`record-picker-label-association.test.tsx:130-132`); "two values that are each present and never match is the failure mode objectui#3341 documents" TRUE (#3341 item 2: `htmlFor` pointing at an id the `SelectTrigger` never carried). `required-marker-markup.test.tsx:136-137`: "The label names the trigger through `for` since objectui#10435, whose own pin (`select-label-association.test.tsx`) reads the resulting name." TRUE.

No `content/docs/**` or README prose is added by the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

**The PR body's own flags and open questions.**

- "`required-marker-markup.test.tsx` is outside the claim's declared file surface." Confirmed, and judged above: a comment that this change made false, plus a tightened locator; not a weakening.
- "NOT MEASURED: `check:sdui-registration-pins` … That gate is declared to CI." CI did measure it: `.github/workflows/performance-budget.yml` (check name `Bundle Analysis`) triggers on `packages/**` and runs `pnpm check:sdui-registration-pins` as an unconditional step after the build; `Bundle Analysis` is `success` at the head. The registration block is unchanged in the diff, consistent with that.
- "type-check … ran on `a75bf59`" not on the merge head: the CI `Type Check` run at the head is the measurement that matters; see the counts below.
- Open question (H2, a `useId` fallback when `schema.id` is absent): the card, the triage note and the ruled 5771 changeset all bind the wiring to the authored `schema.id`, and the ruling explicitly declines the fallback, so following it is correct for this card. A minted id would move every Label/control renderer in the family, and the no-id pins here and in the picker would have to flip together; that is a separate decision, correctly not taken in this PR. The catalog observation is accurate: `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/components-form-select/basic-select.json` authors `label` with no `id` (and `components-form-input/with-label.json` likewise), so those examples render an unnamed control under the ruled shape, as they did before this change. Noted, not filed, correctly out of scope.
- "Files (vs base `111fa4c`)" table: +13/-2, +128/-0, +3/-5, +20/-0 — matches `git diff --stat` against the merge-base exactly.

**CI at the head `4e99a54`** (42 check-runs at polls 1 and 2, 43 at poll 3):

- Poll 1 (about 08:26 UTC): 28 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard)`, `dependabot`), 11 in progress.
- Poll 2 (08:30 UTC): 31 success, 3 skipped, 8 in progress (`Test (shard 1,3,4,5,6,7/8)`, `Type Check`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`).
- Poll 3 (08:33 UTC, the last permitted): 43 check-runs (the `Test` roll-up job appeared and completed), 39 success, 3 skipped, 1 in progress (`Spec Main Shape Gate` only). All eight `Test (shard n/8)` runs, the `Test` roll-up, `Type Check` and `Lint` are `success` at the head.
- No failure, cancellation or neutral conclusion at any poll. Green gates that bear on this diff: the full `Test` matrix and roll-up (the lit run of the new pin and of the edited pin, and of every other components test against the new DOM), `Type Check` (on the merge head, which closes the PR body's own gap), `Lint`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Bundle Analysis` (which runs `check:sdui-registration-pins`), `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `README Export Check`. The one still running, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, reads `@objectstack/spec` shape; this diff consumes no spec symbol.

**Is the PR draft?** Yes (`draft: true`). Correct for a dispatched PR under AGENTS.md: it stays draft until the dispatching seat flips it.

**Does `Clause-②: no` hold?** Yes. No accept set moves: `id` was already an accepted `BaseSchema` key and the `select` registration `inputs` are untouched.
